name: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of 'Electric Vehicles' to Consumers in State of Goa
benefit:
##### ***State Subsidy (Quantum of Subsidy per kilowatt-hour)***

- Financial Year 2021-2022: ₹10,000/- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two Wheelers, Three Wheelers, and Four Wheelers.
- Financial Year 2022-2023: ₹8,000/- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two Wheelers, Three Wheelers, and Four Wheelers.
- Financial Year 2023-2024: ₹6,000/- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two Wheelers, Three Wheelers, and Four W
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Goa. - The applicant must be the registered owner of the Electric Vehicle for which the Purchase Incentive is claimed. - The applicant must ensure the vehicle is an Electric Two Wheeler, Three Wheeler, or Four Wheeler purchased or converted in the State of Goa. - The applicant must purchase the Electric Vehicle from Convergence Energy Services Limited to avail of their low-cost loans and financial incentives.
